description: Discover 23 popular agent skills for development, with original GitHub repositories.

cards.title: Superpowers
cards.description: A comprehensive library of proven techniques for a stronger, more reliable coding agent workflow.
cards.use_when: At the start of a new task, before any code, when you want spec brainstorming, worktree isolation, bite-sized planning, and test-driven development.

inside.name: brainstorming
inside.function: Explores and clarifies user requirements through iterative questioning before building begins, synthesizing understanding into a written design specification.
inside.example_prompt: Help me brainstorm the requirements and architecture for our new user authentication system before we write any code.

inside.name: using-git-worktrees
inside.function: Provisions an isolated development workspace on a separate branch using harness-native tooling or git worktree fallbacks, verifying clean baseline test status before implementation starts.
inside.example_prompt: Set up an isolated git worktree on a new feature branch and verify a clean test baseline before starting work.

inside.name: writing-plans
inside.function: Decomposes an approved design document into granular, bite-sized tasks (2–5 minutes each) specifying exact file paths, full code implementations, and explicit test verification steps.
inside.example_prompt: Create a granular implementation plan with bite-sized tasks, exact file paths, and test verification steps for our approved design.

inside.name: subagent-driven-development
inside.function: Coordinates implementation by dispatching an isolated subagent for each task, followed by two-stage reviews (spec compliance and code quality) after every step.
inside.example_prompt: Execute the plan in docs/superpowers/plans/auth-system.md using subagent-driven development, dispatching fresh subagents with reviews for each task.

inside.name: test-driven-development
inside.function: Enforces a strict Red-Green-Refactor discipline that requires writing a failing test and observing it fail before producing the minimal code required to pass.
inside.example_prompt: Implement the user profile service using strict test-driven development by writing a failing test first before adding production code.

cards.title: ECC
cards.description: An agent-harness optimisation system with skills, memory, security practices, and research-first workflows.
cards.use_when: When running a full-lifecycle workflow in a supported harness that needs planning, test-driven implementation, fresh-context review, and build repair.
cards.inside_note: Featured entries, not the whole catalog.

inside.name: tdd-workflow
inside.function: Directs a complete test-driven development cycle requiring a failing test prior to code implementation, followed by incremental greening and refactoring targeting 80%+ test coverage across unit, integration, and E2E suites.
inside.example_prompt: Reproduce the shopping cart checkout bug with a failing test first, then use tdd-workflow to implement the fix.

inside.name: /ecc:plan
inside.function: Clarifies user requirements, assesses architectural and operational risks, and structures a step-by-step implementation plan while halting for explicit confirmation before code edits occur.
inside.example_prompt: /ecc:plan "Implement user authentication with JWT tokens, role-based access control, and password reset endpoints in our API."

inside.name: /code-review
inside.function: Conducts a structured, fresh-context code review on uncommitted local modifications or GitHub pull requests using a multi-phase checklist for bugs, style, and security.
inside.example_prompt: /code-review Run a fresh-context review on uncommitted local modifications to check for bugs, styling issues, and potential security vulnerabilities.

inside.name: /build-fix
inside.function: Inspects the repository to detect its active build system and iteratively resolves compiler, linter, and type-check errors using minimal, localized changes.
inside.example_prompt: /build-fix Inspect the repository build system and incrementally resolve all TypeScript compiler and linter errors using minimal, localized changes.

inside.name: security-scan
inside.function: Scans the agent harness setup (`.claude/` directory, MCP servers, hooks, and prompt guidelines) for configuration flaws, injection vulnerabilities, and credential exposure using AgentShield.
inside.example_prompt: /security-scan .claude/ to audit our configuration for hardcoded secrets, injection vulnerabilities, and overly permissive MCP server settings.

cards.title: Matt Pocock Skills
cards.description: Skills for real engineers, including alignment interviews and disciplined test-driven loops.
cards.use_when: At the start of feature or bug work, when human grilling should settle ambiguity and shared terminology before tickets and test-driven development.

inside.name: grill-with-docs
inside.function: Interrogates the user in depth about planned changes while writing Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and maintaining a ubiquitous project domain glossary (`GLOSSARY.md`) before work starts.
inside.example_prompt: /grill-with-docs Interview me about our proposed caching architecture while recording architectural decision records and updating our project glossary.

inside.name: grill-me
inside.function: Recursively interviews the user on an idea, plan, or general proposal until every branch of the design decision tree is explored and aligned.
inside.example_prompt: /grill-me Interview me relentlessly about my proposal for a team on-call rotation until every branch of the plan is resolved.

inside.name: to-spec
inside.function: Turns a grilled understanding into a written specification, with implementation seams agreed up front before tickets are cut. (Source: skills/engineering/to-spec/SKILL.md, description + Process steps 2–3; orchestrator-verified 2026-10-29.)
inside.example_prompt: /to-spec Turn our conversation into a complete feature specification, proposing test seams and publishing it to our issue tracker.

inside.name: implement
inside.function: Executes tasks defined by a specification or ticket list, triggering `/tdd` across identified seams and terminating with `/code-review` before committing changes.
inside.example_prompt: /implement Build the feature described in ticket #104, using test-driven development at identified seams and running code review before committing.

inside.name: code-review
inside.function: Performs a dual-axis evaluation of repository diffs comparing code against standards and against the originating spec using parallel, isolated subagents.
inside.example_prompt: Review our current changes since main against repo coding standards and originating issue #45 using parallel subagents for evaluation.

cards.title: Spec Kit
cards.description: A toolkit for spec-driven development that helps agents build from a specification.
cards.use_when: When building a greenfield app or complex multi-step feature whose requirements and tasks must become executable specifications before code is generated.

inside.name: speckit-specify
inside.function: Creates or updates a detailed feature specification (`spec.md`) from natural language requirements, defining functional scope, user stories, and technical constraints.
inside.example_prompt: /speckit-specify Build a photo organizer with albums grouped by date and a tile preview of each album.

inside.name: speckit-plan
inside.function: Executes implementation planning using design templates to generate technical design artifacts, technology choices, and architectural boundaries.
inside.example_prompt: /speckit-plan Use .NET Aspire with Postgres, Blazor Server for the drag-and-drop frontend, and REST APIs for task management.

inside.name: speckit-tasks
inside.function: Decomposes the architectural plan and specification into an actionable, dependency-ordered `tasks.md` checklist for systematic implementation.
inside.example_prompt: /speckit-tasks Break down our technical plan into an actionable, dependency-ordered checklist in tasks.md for systematic feature implementation.

inside.name: speckit-implement
inside.function: Executes the implementation plan by processing and building out each task defined in `tasks.md` with prerequisite validation checks.
inside.example_prompt: /speckit-implement Implement only the Setup and Foundational phases: project scaffolding and the project/task data model with basic CRUD.

inside.name: speckit-converge
inside.function: Audits the codebase against the spec, plan, and tasks, automatically appending any missing or incomplete work as new tasks to `tasks.md` until full convergence is reached.
inside.example_prompt: /speckit-converge Audit our codebase against the spec, plan, and tasks, appending any missing requirements to tasks.md until fully converged.

cards.title: Vercel Skills
cards.description: An open agent skills tool installed with npx skills.
cards.use_when: When you need one CLI to search, install, update, sync, or test-run skills across several coding agent harnesses from git, URLs, or npm.

inside.name: find-skills
inside.function: Instructs an AI coding agent on how to query and install agent skills via the Skills CLI when a user requests capabilities not natively supported.
inside.example_prompt: Find a skill for building responsive HTML emails and install it directly into our current project workspace to style newsletters.

inside.name: skills add
inside.function: Downloads and installs agent skills from GitHub repositories, URLs, or local paths directly into the active project or globally.
inside.example_prompt: skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill web-design-guidelines to configure our project with responsive layout rules and typography standards.

inside.name: skills find
inside.function: Interactively searches the open agent skills ecosystem by keyword query or scopes results to a specific GitHub owner.
inside.example_prompt: skills find react performance --owner vercel-labs to discover verified optimization skills for our frontend application codebase.

inside.name: skills use
inside.function: Generates prompt text or temporarily initializes a coding agent with a specified skill without permanently adding it to project dependencies.
inside.example_prompt: skills use vercel-labs/agent-skills@web-design-guidelines to temporarily load styling rules into this agent session without installing them permanently.

inside.name: skills update
inside.function: Checks for and updates installed project and global skills to their latest upstream releases.
inside.example_prompt: skills update to refresh all installed agent skills to their latest upstream versions and check for breaking configuration changes.

cards.title: pstack
cards.description: Poteto's official Cursor plugin that turns Cursor into a real engineering team, helping you write less but higher quality code with rigorous engineering principles and fearless parallelism via /poteto-mode and its 23 playbooks.
cards.use_when: At the start of a demanding task such as reproducing defects, tracing performance bottlenecks, or overnight autonomous work needing empirical verification.

inside.name: bug-fix
inside.function: Mandates reproducing a reported defect directly on the matching target surface first, binary-searching root causes with runtime evidence, and staging a failing repro test commit before landing the fix.
inside.example_prompt: /poteto-mode users get two notifications after a retry: repro first with a failing test, then fix and verify.

inside.name: feature
inside.function: Orchestrates implementing new or modified behavior by establishing domain data shapes, conducting parallel architectural exploration, writing a four-dimension throughput checkpoint, and delegating scoped implementation.
inside.example_prompt: /poteto-mode Implement webhook signature verification for inbound Stripe events, establishing domain data shapes and throughput checkpoints before delegating scoped code changes.

inside.name: investigation
inside.function: Executes read-only inquiry into how a subsystem functions or why an architectural decision was made, producing cited explanations and tradeoff matrices without introducing code modifications.
inside.example_prompt: /poteto-mode Investigate how our session expiration and token refresh pipeline works, providing cited code explanations and tradeoff analysis without modifying any files.

inside.name: refactoring
inside.function: Performs behavior-preserving structural alterations by first pinning existing contracts with characterization tests, eliminating dead code, and migrating callers and legacy APIs simultaneously in a single wave.
inside.example_prompt: /poteto-mode Refactor the legacy billing service into modular handlers, pinning existing behavior with characterization tests first to ensure zero functional regressions.

inside.name: perf-issue
inside.function: Traces measured slowness against an established baseline trace, systematically applies performance mantras in order of cost, and independently verifies post-fix metric improvements before shipping.
inside.example_prompt: /poteto-mode Trace database query latency on the dashboard endpoint against our baseline profile and optimize the slow queries with verified post-fix benchmarks.

cards.title: Karpathy Skills
cards.description: A single behaviour guide distilled from common LLM coding pitfalls.
cards.use_when: During a non-trivial coding task where models tend to assume silently, add speculative abstractions, edit unrelated code, or skip verifiable test loops.
cards.inside_summary: Inside this repo — the only skill

inside.name: karpathy-guidelines
inside.function: Enforces four foundational behavioral principles (Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, and Goal-Driven Execution) to curb AI over-engineering, unstated assumptions, and extraneous edits.
inside.example_prompt: Follow the karpathy-guidelines to add a feature to export user data, clarifying assumptions and delivering minimal surgical changes with verified tests.

cards.title: Agent Skills
cards.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
cards.use_when: When guiding an agent through multi-stage feature delivery that needs requirements, specs, tests, security passes, and human checkpoints to prevent shortcuts.

inside.name: /spec
inside.function: Authors a comprehensive PRD covering objectives, commands, directory structure, testing strategy, and boundaries before writing any code.
inside.example_prompt: /spec Author a complete product requirements document for adding role-based access control with admin permissions and audit logging before implementation.

inside.name: /plan
inside.function: Decomposes specifications into small, atomic, verifiable implementation tasks ordered by dependency with clear acceptance criteria.
inside.example_prompt: /plan Decompose our user authentication specification into small, atomic implementation tasks ordered by dependency with explicit acceptance criteria.

inside.name: /build
inside.function: Implements changes in vertical slices—coding, testing, verifying, and committing atomically with safe defaults and feature flags.
inside.example_prompt: /build Implement the user registration slice from our plan, writing tests and verifying functionality before committing each change atomically.

inside.name: /test
inside.function: Enforces a strict Red-Green-Refactor cycle following the test pyramid to verify functional correctness and prevent regressions.
inside.example_prompt: /test Apply a strict Red-Green-Refactor cycle to implement input validation for email signups, writing failing tests first before production code.

inside.name: /review
inside.function: Conducts a five-axis pre-merge quality and code health review evaluating architecture, correctness, tests, security, and maintainability.
inside.example_prompt: /review Conduct a five-axis pre-merge review of our authentication pull request, evaluating correctness, architecture, tests, security, and maintainability.

cards.title: UI/UX Pro Max
cards.description: Design intelligence for professional, polished user interfaces.
cards.use_when: When building, refactoring, or auditing an interface that needs concrete choices on palette, font pairing, responsive layout, and accessibility compliance.

inside.name: ui-ux-pro-max
inside.function: Delivers searchable, stack-specific design intelligence across 22 frameworks, covering UI styles, color palettes, font pairings, animations, and UX best practices.
inside.example_prompt: Build a landing page for my SaaS product with dark mode, modern typography pairings, and accessible shadcn/ui components.

inside.name: design-system
inside.function: Generates multi-tiered design token architectures (primitive, semantic, component), CSS variables, component specifications, and presentation slide structures.
inside.example_prompt: Generate a complete design system for our analytics dashboard, establishing primitive, semantic, and component token layers with CSS variables.

inside.name: ui-styling
inside.function: Directs the creation of accessible web interfaces utilizing shadcn/ui components, Tailwind CSS utility patterns, and visual canvas layouts.
inside.example_prompt: Style our user settings dashboard using accessible shadcn/ui components, responsive Tailwind CSS utility classes, and custom dark mode themes.

inside.name: design
inside.function: Coordinates broad branding and graphic deliverables, including logo creation, corporate identity programs, social cards, mockups, and icon generation.
inside.example_prompt: Design a complete brand identity package including modern SVG vector icons, social preview cards, and corporate presentation slide templates.

inside.name: banner-design
inside.function: Designs responsive digital and print banners across social platforms, display advertising, and website hero sections using preset art direction styles.
inside.example_prompt: Create a set of responsive promotional banners for our product launch across Twitter, LinkedIn, and website hero sections using glassmorphism styling.

cards.title: Taste Skill
cards.description: Agent skills that give coding agents design taste, with art direction, reference images, and a browser check.
cards.use_when: When a landing page, portfolio, or app screen looks generic or AI-made and needs custom, premium art direction.
cards.inside_summary: Inside this repo — the only skill
cards.inside_note: Earlier classic variants moved to satellite repos.

inside.name: design-taste-frontend
inside.function: Applies researched art directions, sources real open-archive media, and enforces an anti-slop house style with automated real-browser screenshot audits for public pages and app screens.
inside.example_prompt: Build a landing page for Ledgerly, an invoicing tool for freelance designers, with pricing and a short FAQ.

cards.title: Impeccable
cards.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent, steering with polish and bolder, reviewing with critique and audit, and catching AI slop before it ships.
cards.use_when: When designing, critiquing, polishing, or auditing frontend interfaces to elevate craft and catch AI design slop before shipping.

inside.name: init
inside.function: Runs project discovery once per project, asking only what it cannot infer, and writes PRODUCT.md that every later command reads.
inside.example_prompt: Run /impeccable init for this project, discovering its users, jobs, and constraints and writing the PRODUCT.md every later command will read.

inside.name: polish
inside.function: Refines an existing interface for shipping without redesigning it, fixing blockers, missing states, drift, and visual inconsistencies in priority order.
inside.example_prompt: /impeccable polish the settings page, refining it for shipping without redesigning it and fixing missing states and visual inconsistencies first.

inside.name: bolder
inside.function: Amplifies a safe or bland interface to the conviction the rest of the design system already implies, scoped to the named target only.
inside.example_prompt: /impeccable bolder the pricing cards, amplifying their hierarchy and visual conviction without rebuilding the surrounding page or adding effects.

inside.name: critique
inside.function: Scores a design against usability heuristics with dual isolated assessments and detector evidence, ranking what to fix first.
inside.example_prompt: /impeccable critique the pricing cards, scoring the design against usability heuristics and ranking the fixes that matter most first.

inside.name: audit
inside.function: Checks accessibility, performance, theming, responsive behaviour, and implementation integrity, ranking findings P0 (blocking) to P3 (polish).
inside.example_prompt: Run /impeccable audit on the checkout flow, checking accessibility, performance, theming, and responsive behaviour and ranking findings from P0 to P3.

cards.title: Caveman
cards.description: Concise, token-efficient agent communication.
cards.use_when: In interactive terminal coding sessions where replies pile up token waste, latency, and conversational filler.
cards.inside_note: Featured entries, not the whole catalog.

inside.name: /caveman
inside.function: Enforces an ultra-concise, structured communication style (answer first, one idea per sentence, eliminating conversational filler) while preserving code, file paths, commands, and numbers character-for-character.
inside.example_prompt: /caveman explain why my React component re-renders every time the parent updates and how to memoize props without breaking state.

inside.name: /ultracave
inside.function: Compresses agent communication to maximum brevity using sentence fragments and single-word answers while stating each technical fact only once.
inside.example_prompt: /ultracave diagnose why my long-running Node.js worker leaks memory and recommend minimal fixes without conversational pleasantries.

inside.name: /caveman-compress
inside.function: Shrinks agent steering and memory files (e.g., `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`) to conserve context window tokens while backing up originals and keeping headings, code blocks, and paths intact.
inside.example_prompt: /caveman-compress CLAUDE.md to shrink this project memory file and conserve context window tokens before starting development.

inside.name: /caveman-review
inside.function: Performs a dense code review outputting exactly one finding per line anchored to code line numbers without discursive preambles.
inside.example_prompt: /caveman-review the current pull request diff and output exactly one actionable finding per line with severity, location, and fix.

inside.name: investigate-first
inside.function: Enforces a disciplined debugging playbook requiring the agent to gather log/test evidence and confirm a credible failure mechanism before any code edits are authorized.
inside.example_prompt: Investigate the intermittent timeout failures in our payment service by tracing failure evidence and ranking hypotheses without modifying product code.

cards.title: Graphify
cards.description: Turns a codebase into an explorable knowledge graph.
cards.use_when: When exploring an unfamiliar codebase or a mixed folder of code, PDFs, notes, and images that needs a persistent, queryable graph of cross-file links.

inside.name: /graphify
inside.function: Executes the full deterministic AST parsing and extraction pipeline on a codebase to detect communities, identify god nodes, and generate an interactive HTML visual graph, GraphRAG-ready JSON, and a `GRAPH_REPORT.md` architecture summary.
inside.example_prompt: /graphify . --mode deep to extract AST dependencies, identify god nodes, and generate the architecture report for this codebase.

inside.name: graphify query
inside.function: Answers architecture and code relationship questions using deterministic graph traversal (BFS or semantic search) against local graph artifacts instead of grepping raw source files.
inside.example_prompt: Run graphify query "what connects auth to the database?" using BFS traversal to trace component dependencies without reading raw files.

inside.name: graphify path
inside.function: Traces and outputs the dependency and call connection paths between two specified components or god nodes within the knowledge graph.
inside.example_prompt: Run graphify path "UserService" "DatabasePool" to trace all intermediary call chains and dependencies connecting these two components.

inside.name: graphify explain
inside.function: Inspects a specific node or component in the graph and summarizes its architectural role, community membership, upstream dependencies, and downstream dependents.
inside.example_prompt: Run graphify explain "RateLimiter" to summarize its architectural role, community membership, upstream dependencies, and downstream caller components.

inside.name: graphify add
inside.function: Ingests, parses, or transcribes an external artifact (such as an arXiv paper URL, YouTube video, or document) and merges its extracted entities into the existing project graph.
inside.example_prompt: Run graphify add https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.03762 to ingest this transformer architecture paper and merge its concepts into our graph.

cards.title: Understand-Anything
cards.description: Turns any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph to explore, search, and ask questions about.
cards.use_when: When onboarding onto a large unfamiliar repository of 200,000+ lines and you need a visual dashboard of architecture layers, business flows, and diff impact.

inside.name: understand
inside.function: Scans the project with tree-sitter and a multi-agent pipeline to extract files, functions, classes, and dependencies into an incremental knowledge graph saved in `.ua/knowledge-graph.json`.
inside.example_prompt: /understand to scan our project with tree-sitter, extract all dependencies, and generate the initial knowledge graph in .ua/.

inside.name: understand-dashboard
inside.function: Launches an interactive, web-based visual dashboard displaying the codebase knowledge graph color-coded by architectural layer with search and inspection capabilities.
inside.example_prompt: /understand-dashboard to launch the interactive web visualizer and inspect our project knowledge graph color-coded by architectural layer.

inside.name: understand-chat
inside.function: Answers natural language architectural and flow questions about the project by traversing the indexed knowledge graph without reading entire raw files.
inside.example_prompt: /understand-chat How does the payment flow work from user checkout down through the payment gateway and transaction logging?

inside.name: understand-diff
inside.function: Evaluates git diffs and pending code modifications against the knowledge graph to determine structural impact, affected dependencies, and downstream blast radius.
inside.example_prompt: /understand-diff to evaluate our uncommitted git modifications against the knowledge graph and report affected downstream components and risks.

inside.name: understand-explain
inside.function: Performs a focused architectural breakdown of a specified file, class, or function, detailing its structural role, callers, callees, and dependencies.
inside.example_prompt: /understand-explain src/auth/login.ts to break down its structural role, callers, callees, and imported dependencies across our codebase.

cards.title: Anthropic Skills
cards.description: The official public repository for Agent Skills from Anthropic.
cards.use_when: When Claude needs multi-step procedural guidance for domain tasks like DOCX, PDF, PPTX, and XLSX generation, web app testing, or MCP server scaffolding.

inside.name: pdf
inside.function: Reads, extracts text and tabular data, merges, splits, rotates, watermarks, creates, fills forms, encrypts/decrypts, and runs OCR on PDF files.
inside.example_prompt: Extract all financial summary tables from quarterly-report.pdf and merge pages one through five with our signed appendix document.

inside.name: docx
inside.function: Creates, reads, edits, and manipulates Microsoft Word documents (.docx) and templates (.dotx) with structured styling, tables of contents, letterheads, and tracked changes.
inside.example_prompt: Generate a professional project kickoff report as a Word document (.docx) with a table of contents, executive summary, and letterhead.

inside.name: xlsx
inside.function: Reads, edits, formats, calculates formulas, generates charts, cleans messy data, and creates Microsoft Excel spreadsheets (.xlsx, .xlsm, .csv).
inside.example_prompt: Clean the messy raw sales CSV in my downloads, format it as an xlsx spreadsheet, and calculate quarterly revenue formulas.

inside.name: pptx
inside.function: Creates, reads, extracts text from, updates, and formats Microsoft PowerPoint slide decks and templates (.pptx, .potx), including speaker notes and layouts.
inside.example_prompt: Create a ten-slide pitch deck presentation in 16:9 widescreen format (.pptx) summarizing our quarterly product roadmap and speaker notes.

inside.name: skill-creator
inside.function: Provides instructions and workflows for creating new custom skills from scratch, improving existing skills, running evals, and optimizing skill descriptions for triggering accuracy.
inside.example_prompt: I want to make a new custom skill for automated semantic database migrations, so help me draft and evaluate it.

cards.title: Scientific Agent Skills
cards.description: A library that turns an AI agent into an AI scientist with specialised scientific skills.
cards.use_when: When running workflows in genomics, cheminformatics, physics, clinical research, or lab automation that need vetted links to 100+ scientific databases.

inside.name: database-lookup
inside.function: Executes reproducible queries against 80 documented scientific, regulatory, and financial database APIs with explicit endpoint selection, pagination, and provenance tracking.
inside.example_prompt: Query the ChEMBL database for small-molecule inhibitors of EGFR, returning verified binding affinities, endpoints, and pagination details with provenance.

inside.name: scanpy
inside.function: Drives single-cell RNA-seq workflows encompassing quality control, normalization, high-variable gene selection, clustering, marker ranking, and AnnData file conversion.
inside.example_prompt: Run quality control and normalization on this single-cell RNA-seq dataset, then cluster the cells and identify marker genes with Scanpy.

inside.name: rdkit
inside.function: Provides programmatic cheminformatics routines for SMILES/SDF parsing, molecular descriptor calculation, substructure searching, and 2D/3D structure generation.
inside.example_prompt: Parse the provided SDF compound library, filter molecules by Lipinski's rule of five using RDKit, and generate 2D depiction images.

inside.name: autoskill
inside.function: Analyzes recorded Screenpipe user activity windows to detect repetitive computational research workflows and draft candidate skill definitions.
inside.example_prompt: Analyze my recorded Screenpipe activity windows from the last four hours to detect repetitive data workflows and draft a reusable skill.

inside.name: paperclip
inside.function: Searches and extracts biomedical literature, FDA/PMDA/EMA filings, and clinical trial records using the Paperclip CLI with line-pinned citation tracking.
inside.example_prompt: Search recent clinical trials and FDA filings for GLP-1 receptor agonists with Paperclip, extracting safety evidence with line-pinned citations.

cards.title: Obsidian Skills
cards.description: Agent skills for using Obsidian through its CLI and open Markdown formats.
cards.use_when: When a task writes wikilinks, embeds, or callouts, edits canvas or base files, or manages vault state through the Obsidian CLI.

inside.name: obsidian-markdown
inside.function: Authors and edits Obsidian Flavored Markdown notes using wikilinks, transclusions, embeds, callout blocks, and YAML frontmatter properties.
inside.example_prompt: Create a new project dashboard note in Obsidian Flavored Markdown using YAML frontmatter properties, embedded note transclusions, wikilinks, and warning callouts.

inside.name: obsidian-bases
inside.function: Creates and configures Obsidian Base files (`.base`) with database-like table views, filter criteria, formulas, and property summaries.
inside.example_prompt: Create an Obsidian Base file with a table view to organize our project tasks, filtering by status and calculating completion percentages.

inside.name: json-canvas
inside.function: Constructs and edits visual JSON Canvas files (`.canvas`) comprising nodes, directional edges, grouping boundaries, and connection metadata.
inside.example_prompt: Build a visual architecture diagram as an Obsidian JSON Canvas file with labeled nodes, grouped component boundaries, and directional connection edges.

inside.name: obsidian-cli
inside.function: Operates active Obsidian desktop vaults through the `obsidian` CLI to manipulate notes, search vaults, reload plugins, and execute JavaScript.
inside.example_prompt: Search my active Obsidian vault for uncompleted action items and append a formatted summary list into today's daily note using obsidian-cli.

inside.name: defuddle
inside.function: Extracts clean, readable Markdown from arbitrary HTML web pages via the Defuddle CLI, eliminating clutter and adverts to minimize token usage.
inside.example_prompt: Extract the full article from the URL I give you into clean readable Markdown using Defuddle, stripping navigation menus, banners, and advertising clutter.

cards.title: Google Skills
cards.description: Agent skills for Google products and technologies.
cards.use_when: When designing or configuring services on Google Cloud, Gemini APIs, Firebase, Android, or Google Ads, or weighing Google products for a stack component.
cards.inside_note: Featured entries, not the whole catalog.

inside.name: finding-google-skills
inside.function: Serves as Google's dynamic skills catalog router, inspecting user task requirements and fetching matching Google platform decision, setup, and architecture skills on demand from `index.json`.
inside.example_prompt: Find and load the appropriate Google Cloud database skills from the catalog index to help me migrate MySQL to Cloud SQL.

inside.name: google-cloud-recipe-auth
inside.function: Delivers authoritative guidance on Google Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM), configuring human and service identities, Application Default Credentials (ADC), and required API attribution headers.
inside.example_prompt: Configure Application Default Credentials and least-privilege IAM service account roles for our backend service to securely access Google Cloud Storage.

inside.name: google-cloud-recipe-onboarding
inside.function: Provides a streamlined, non-interactive onboarding flow for individual developers getting started on Google Cloud, handling account setup, billing linkage, project creation, and initial resource deployment.
inside.example_prompt: Walk me through the developer onboarding flow to set up a new Google Cloud project, link billing, and enable required APIs.

inside.name: google-cloud-recipe-foundation-builder
inside.function: Deploys a baseline landing zone foundation for an enterprise Google Cloud Organization, establishing organizational security guardrails, folder hierarchies, billing links, and centralized logging.
inside.example_prompt: Deploy a secure baseline landing zone foundation for our enterprise Google Cloud Organization with folder hierarchies, guardrails, and centralized audit logging.

inside.name: google-cloud-solution-architecture
inside.function: Interactively gathers workload requirements to design holistic, multi-product Google Cloud solution blueprints, service integration plans, and architecture diagrams.
inside.example_prompt: Gather our requirements interactively and design a multi-product Google Cloud architecture blueprint for a real-time event streaming and analytics platform.

cards.title: Agentic Awesome Skills
cards.description: A large catalog of agentic skills for discovering, comparing, and planning which skills to use.
cards.use_when: When an autonomous agent should inspect your codebase, search a skill catalog over read-only MCP, and produce a validated stack manifest with plan preview.
cards.inside_note: Featured entries, not the whole catalog.

inside.name: brainstorming
inside.function: Guides the agent through collaborative reasoning and inquiry to refine ambiguous requirements and creative ideas into validated architectural designs before implementation.
inside.example_prompt: Use @brainstorming to help me design a user profile page with authentication and dark mode before writing any application code.

inside.name: concise-planning
inside.function: Generates actionable, atomic, and structured task checklists to organize coding tasks before source modification begins.
inside.example_prompt: Create an actionable, atomic implementation plan with ordered task items and validation steps before modifying our authentication API codebase.

inside.name: test-driven-development
inside.function: Directs implementation through failing behavioral tests first, followed by code implementation and refactoring within verified regression boundaries.
inside.example_prompt: Implement the shopping cart discount calculation using test-driven development, writing a failing behavioral test first before writing production code.

inside.name: lint-and-validate
inside.function: Executes configured linting and type checks, differentiates actual failures from unexecuted checks, and reports concrete validation diagnostics.
inside.example_prompt: Run configured linter and type-checker audits across the repository, reporting concrete diagnostics and fixing all detected syntax and style errors.

inside.name: systematic-debugging
inside.function: Investigates errors, test failures, and unexpected application behaviors methodically from empirical evidence and structured hypotheses rather than speculative guessing.
inside.example_prompt: Investigate our checkout timeout failure by formulating hypotheses from server logs and reproducing the root cause before attempting code fixes.

cards.title: Awesome Claude Code
cards.description: A curated collection of Claude Code skills, agents, and developer tooling.
cards.use_when: When configuring Claude Code and you want a selective directory of vetted tools, status lines, hooks, subagents, and guides that meet maturity thresholds.
cards.inside_note: Featured entries, not the whole catalog.

inside.name: Caveman
inside.function: Compresses agent communication tokens by instructing Claude Code to converse in concise, fragmented "caveman speak."
inside.example_prompt: /caveman explain why my React component re-renders whenever its parent updates and how to memoize props without breaking state.

inside.name: Claude Code Infrastructure Showcase
inside.function: Implements dynamic skill selection by using lifecycle hooks to automatically detect and activate relevant skills based on active context.
inside.example_prompt: Configure dynamic skill selection using lifecycle hooks and skill-rules.json so relevant guidelines activate automatically as I edit API controllers and routes.

inside.name: Cooklang skills
inside.function: Allows AI coding agents to parse, create, and manage Cooklang recipe files (`.cook`) and meal plans (`.menu`).
inside.example_prompt: Plan dinners for next week using my existing recipes, format them into a menu file, and generate the shopping list.

inside.name: daily.dev
inside.function: Fetches curated developer news feeds and community insights from the daily.dev platform directly into an agent session.
inside.example_prompt: Fetch today's top developer news and trending articles on TypeScript architecture from daily.dev directly into this agent session.

inside.name: fable-mode
inside.function: Configures Claude Code for autonomous multi-stage planning, sub-agent delegation, and automated self-verification loops.
inside.example_prompt: /fable-mode Refactor our authentication middleware into modular stages with subagent delegation, automated test verification, and cold self-critique reviews.

cards.title: Claude Plugins Official
cards.description: The official Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code plugins.
cards.use_when: When you want to discover and install Anthropic-vetted or partner-vetted commands, MCP configurations, agents, and skill bundles inside Claude Code.
cards.inside_note: Featured entries, not the whole catalog.

inside.name: skill-creator
inside.function: Guides users through creating, refining, evaluating, and benchmarking custom Claude Code agent skills with variance analysis.
inside.example_prompt: I want to make a new skill for automating database migrations, so help me design, draft, and run evaluations on it.

inside.name: plugin-dev
inside.function: Provides developer tooling and procedural guidelines for constructing Claude Code plugins, custom commands, hooks, and MCP servers.
inside.example_prompt: /plugin-dev:create-plugin Build a plugin for managing PostgreSQL schema migrations with custom slash commands, lifecycle hooks, and validation checks.

inside.name: feature-dev
inside.function: Orchestrates a 7-phase feature development workflow utilizing specialized subagents for code exploration, architectural design, and implementation review.
inside.example_prompt: /feature-dev Add user authentication with OAuth and role-based permissions using specialized subagents for exploration, architecture, and code review.

inside.name: code-review
inside.function: Performs multi-agent automated code reviews on git pull requests, generating prioritized issues scored by confidence.
inside.example_prompt: /code-review Run automated multi-agent code review on this pull request to identify high-confidence bugs and convention issues.

inside.name: commit-commands
inside.function: Streamlines routine git repository workflows via dedicated commands for drafting commit messages (`/commit`), pushing PRs (`/commit-push-pr`), and pruning stale branches (`/clean_gone`).
inside.example_prompt: /commit-push-pr Stage our local changes, write a conventional commit message, push this branch, and create a GitHub pull request.

cards.title: Awesome Agent Skills
cards.description: A curated collection of 1000+ agent skills from official teams and the community.
cards.use_when: When you need production-ready skills authored by engineering teams such as Supabase, Stripe, Sentry, and Vercel, usable across several coding assistants.
cards.inside_note: Featured entries, not the whole catalog.

inside.name: anthropics/docx
inside.function: Enables coding agents to inspect, create, edit, and format Microsoft Word (`.docx`) documents.
inside.example_prompt: Create a formatted project specification Word document (.docx) with a table of contents, executive summary, and custom header styling.

inside.name: anthropics/doc-coauthoring
inside.function: Structures multi-turn collaborative document authoring, drafting, and iterative editorial reviews.
inside.example_prompt: Help me co-author an engineering RFC for our caching architecture through iterative context gathering, outline refinement, and reader testing.

inside.name: anthropics/pptx
inside.function: Generates, updates, and formats Microsoft PowerPoint presentation slide decks (`.pptx`).
inside.example_prompt: Generate a ten-slide widescreen 16:9 .pptx pitch deck covering our quarterly product roadmap, with speaker notes on every slide.

inside.name: anthropics/xlsx
inside.function: Creates, edits, and analyzes Microsoft Excel spreadsheets (`.xlsx`) including cell formulas, sheets, and tabular formatting.
inside.example_prompt: Clean this raw customer orders CSV, convert it into an Excel spreadsheet (.xlsx), and calculate monthly revenue formulas across sheets.

inside.name: anthropics/pdf
inside.function: Extracts text and tables, parses structured forms, and compiles printable PDF documents.
inside.example_prompt: Pull every financial summary table out of quarterly-report.pdf and merge its first five pages with our signed appendix PDF.

cards.title: Claude Skills Collection
cards.description: A collection of 380 Claude Code skills and plugins for engineering, product, research, and more.
cards.use_when: When you need cross-functional playbooks for executive advisory, marketing, compliance, or research, plus zero-dependency Python analysis and conversion tools.

inside.name: skill-security-auditor
inside.function: Scans and audits AI agent skills for malicious execution patterns, subprocess calls, network data exfiltration, prompt injections, and supply-chain risks before installation, returning a strict PASS, WARN, or FAIL verdict.
inside.example_prompt: Audit the candidate agent skill at ./custom-skill for prompt injection vectors, malicious execution patterns, and data exfiltration before installation.

inside.name: pw
inside.function: Provides a comprehensive end-to-end Playwright testing toolkit to generate tests, diagnose and repair flaky test failures, migrate suites from Cypress or Selenium, and integrate with BrowserStack and TestRail.
inside.example_prompt: /pw:fix Diagnose and fix intermittent timeout failures in our checkout flow Playwright tests by analyzing test traces and updating locators.

inside.name: self-improving-agent
inside.function: Analyzes and curates auto-memory entries across agent sessions, promoting recurring patterns and debugging insights into durable project rules (`CLAUDE.md`) or extracting them into reusable custom skills.
inside.example_prompt: /si:memory-review Analyze our project MEMORY.md to identify recurring debugging insights and promote proven patterns into permanent CLAUDE.md rules.

inside.name: karpathy-coder
inside.function: Enforces Andrej Karpathy's four core coding principles—surfacing assumptions, radical simplicity, surgical diffs, and verifiable success criteria—using automated complexity checkers, diff linters, and review hooks.
inside.example_prompt: /karpathy-check Review my staged changes against the four principles to verify minimal diff noise, simple architecture, and test verification.

inside.name: grill-me
inside.function: Relentlessly interviews the user one question at a time to stress-test architectural plans and designs, exploring the codebase first before asking questions and systematically resolving decision dependencies.
inside.example_prompt: /cs:grill-me Grill me one question at a time to stress-test our caching architecture proposal and resolve design decision dependencies.
